integrity: The symbolic proof and a standalone exact checker are supplied; finite computations are not used to infer unbounded claims.
scientific_limitations: Proves conditional expectations, strict finite-grid concavity and maximizing-height asymptotics; no conditional stochastic-order, local-limit, concentration or independent-priority claim. The explicit classical Narayana and ballot formulae are credited as proof ingredients.
title: A midpoint-height peak reversal and cube-root optimum in uniform Dyck excursions
